domains: night vision functioning / symptoms under low luminance (mesopic)
response_scale: items 1-4: 5-option difficulty (None to Stopped doing this because of your eyesight); items 5-10: 4-option bother (Not at all bothered to Very bothered)
scoring: Rasch analysis (Winsteps V.3.68) person measure in logits; higher = more severe night vision symptoms
target_population: adults with intermediate AMD in this paper
notes: derived from 4 NEI VFQ-25 items and 6 items of a night vision symptom list (p2); items 1-3 unscorable if 'Stopped for other reasons'/'Not currently driving'; item list in online supplementary table S1 (not in text); Rasch applied here to the data, not a formal validation (p2)
